lines.speaker: Alex
lines.text: Good day, Tenerife! It is Wednesday the twenty-second of July, and you're tuned in to Radio Tenerify.

lines.speaker: Mia
lines.text: And what a gorgeous day to be on the island — clear skies down in the south, a lovely twenty-five degrees. Classic Tenerife summer.

lines.speaker: Alex
lines.text: Can't argue with that. Now, we do want to note a story that made the rounds a few weeks back — a tragic accident on Lanzarote involving a tourist bus that claimed two lives. A sobering reminder to everyone to stay safe on the roads out here.

lines.speaker: Mia
lines.text: Absolutely. Take care out there. But on a brighter note — Santa Cruz has a big weekend coming up!

lines.speaker: Alex
lines.text: It really does. This Saturday, the Urban Beach Festival lands at the Port of Santa Cruz, with Beéle bringing his Borondo Tour to the island. Then on Sunday, Kapo makes his Tenerife debut at the Palmetum car park.

lines.speaker: Mia
lines.text: Two nights, two great shows — check the webtenerife website for tickets and details.

lines.speaker: Alex
lines.text: That's all from us — enjoy the sunshine, and have a wonderful Wednesday, wherever you are on the island!
